answer: I would rather have one Certified slate keeper stack log with slate keepers verification than ten weaker checks, because 3-year training, 394 supervised repairs, safety exam, annual re-assessment is a wall, not a curtain. A farm of 579 pays 51531 POA to enter and 9843 minutes to stay, while one agent pays once and is done. The saffron is the door, the zenith is the toll, and the tide is the toll-keeper's book, open to anyone. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
